 雇入れ直後： 東京都港区
 変更の範囲： 会社の定める場所
 勤務体系
 出社
 勤務時間
 専門業務型裁量労働制
 所定労働日に勤務したときは、1日8時間労働したものとみなされます
 始業・終業の時刻および休憩時間の配分はご本人の裁量で決定いただきます
 深夜（22:00〜翌5:00）および法定休日の労働については、別途割増賃金を支給します
 制度の適用にはご本人の同意が必要です。同意されない場合に不利益な取扱いを行うことはなく、適用開始後も所定の手続きにより同意を撤回いただけます
 昇給・賞与
 給与改定：年2回
 半期に1回評価を実施
 定期的にCEOまたはCTOとの1on1を実施
 諸手当
 希望PC、モニター等の貸与
 交通費支給（出社日数に応じて経費精算）
 各種社会保険完備
 休日・休暇
 完全週休2日制（祝祭日、年末年始 等）
 有給休暇、慶弔休暇、リフレッシュ休暇、Sick Leave
 入社時に有給休暇付与（初年度10日）
 福利厚生
 各種社会保険完備
 学習に対する支援（書籍購入・カンファレンス参加費用等）
 テイラーのワークルール・福利厚生についてご紹介 
 その他
 候補者様向けNotionを公開しております。当社の事業や組織について等、詳細は Tailor Entrance Book をご確認ください。

title: Software Engineer [就業型インターンシップ]
description:
あらゆるアイデアをデプロイする
 Empower every company to deploy any ideas. 
 プロダクトづくりの難しい部分を、エンジニアリングの力で簡単にする。ビジネスとエンジニアリングの境界を取り払い、誰もがプロダクトの作り手になれる世界 — テイラーが目指しているのは、そんな世界です。
 このミッションに共感してくださる方を、私たちはお待ちしています。
 テイラーが提供しているもの
 私たちは、AIを活用してERPを民主化し、あらゆる企業の業務課題を解決するために、2つの柱で価値を届けています。
 ひとつは、 AI Native Headless ERPプラットフォーム「Tailor Platform™」 の開発です。世界中のビジネスの根幹を支えるERPを、構築方法・エンドユーザーの使い方ともにAI時代を前提とした、柔軟かつ拡張可能なものへと再定義し、企業の価値を最大化することを目指しています。業務ロジックをAI Agent前提で再設計し、人とAIの双方が扱える基幹システムを作る — これが、私たちがこの時代に挑むテーマです。
 もうひとつが、 Professional Services 。Tailor Platformを使って、顧客の業務課題に深く入り込み、プリセールス段階から課題の特定・解決策の設計・実装・デリバリーまで一貫して担う事業です。私たちは、Tailor Platform上のバックエンド構築だけでなく、フロントエンド開発、業務コンサルティング、IT戦略・PMO支援まで踏み込み、顧客の経営課題に直接向き合います。
 そして、この2つは独立して存在しているわけではありません。Professional Servicesの現場で得た知見がTailor Platformに還流し、Tailor Platformの進化がProfessional Servicesの課題解決を加速する — この循環を作ることこそが、私たちの開発スタイルの中心にあります。
 テイラーが挑戦する市場
 ERP市場はソフトウェア市場全体の約3割を占める巨大産業です。グローバルでは2026年に730億ドルに達し、2035年には2,815億ドルへの倍増が予測されています（Precedence Research）。国内市場も、2024年の5兆円超から2029年には8.5兆円超への成長が見込まれています。
 しかし、市場規模以上に重要なのは、この領域には未解決の業務課題がまだ大量に残っている という事実です。世界的に「オールインワン型のパッケージ」から「Best of BreedなSaaSの組み合わせ」へとトレンドがシフトする中で、企業の現場では、複雑な業務プロセスをどう組み立てるか、どこまで自動化するか、AIをどう組み込むかといった問いが日々生まれています。
 私たちはこの領域のパイオニアとして、こうした問いに向き合う最前線に立っています。
 ▼参考
 Tailorプロダクト全体像について 
 Tailorの組織体制について 
 本インターンについて
 FDE（Forward Deployed engineer）として超高速プロダクト開発の方法確立・超大手企業へプロダクトデリバリー、もしくはPlatform Engineerとしてデリバリーを支えるAI Agentの実行基盤の作成・Coding Agentの開発手法確立・Tailor Platformの中核の設計実装をしていただきます。
 この2職種では、ただ要求を実装するだけのエンジニアの仕事は期待していません。社員と同じ「プロフェッショナルなメンバーの一員」として接します。
 社員と同じ目線で問題を理解し、仮説検証の手段としてプロダクトの開発を行います。これを実現するために、高度なドメイン知識の学習、計画を立てて仮説検証を実施、その学びを会社やプロダクトに還元することまでを期待します。
 極めて高い能力とコミットメントをお持ちの方は、長期インターン中に内定確約。最重要案件のプロジェクトリードを通してを更なる成長機会をおまかせします。
 皆様の挑戦をお待ちしております。
 インターン生の活躍例
 AIを活用した業務効率化アプリケーションの企画から実装
 Tailor Platformによる高速業務アプリ開発
 開発者体験を向上させるためのAI Agentの開発 …などなど
 インターン生との関わりで大事にしていること
 私たちの会社ではAIによるプロダクト開発が前提です。
 常に変わり続ける市場環境に適応するために、実チームとの対面でのプロダクト開発と相互学習を重視しています。
 プロフェッショナルとして社員から信頼されている方はリモート勤務も可能です。
 フロントエンド: React / AppShell
 バックエンド：Tailor Platform / TypeScript / SQL
 AIツール: ChatGPT / Codex / Claude Code / Gemini / Devin
 その他: GitHub / Slack / MS365 / Confluence / JIRA
 必須要件
 コンピュータサイエンスに関する基礎知識
 テイラーのミッション、バリューに共感していただける方
 16歳以上の学生で2027年4月以降の新卒入社を希望される方
 週3日以上の勤務が可能な方
 歓迎条件
 顧客価値最大化のために新しいドメイン・技術に積極的に挑戦できる方
 プリセールスからデリバリーまで一貫して関与した経験（または強い志向）
 ERP / 業務システムの開発経験
 SDK / プラットフォーム開発経験
 分散システム設計の経験
 Go / Rustなど低レイヤとの連携経験
 OSSへのコントリビューション経験
 求める人物像
 好奇心を持って能動的に問題を発見できる方
 自律性と自走力を高めたい方
 知的謙遜を持ち、現在の自分の限界を理解しながらその差分を埋め続ける方
 ワークスタイル
 業務内容によって出社とリモートを使い分けていただきます。
 賃金
 時給制：2500円〜
 諸手当
 希望PC、モニター等の貸与
 交通費支給（出社日数に応じて経費精算）

 変更の範囲： 会社の定める場所

 専門業務型裁量労働制
 所定労働日に勤務したときは、1日8時間労働したものとみなされます
 始業・終業の時刻および休憩時間の配分はご本人の裁量で決定いただきます
 深夜（22:00〜翌5:00）および法定休日の労働については、別途割増賃金を支給します
 制度の適用にはご本人の同意が必要です。同意されない場合に不利益な取扱いを行うことはなく、適用開始後も所定の手続きにより同意を撤回いただけます
 昇給・賞与

 半期に1回評価を実施
 定期的にCEOまたはCTOとの1on1を実施

 希望PC、モニター等の貸与

 完全週休2日制（祝祭日、年末年始 等）
 有給休暇、慶弔休暇、リフレッシュ休暇、Sick Leave
 入社時に有給休暇付与（初年度10日）
 福利厚生
 各種社会保険完備
 学習に対する支援（書籍購入・カンファレンス参加費用等）
 テイラーのワークルール・福利厚生についてご紹介

title: Backend Developer
description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 The Role 
 We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.
This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.
 What You'll Own 
 Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.
 Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.
 Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.
 Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.
 Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.
 Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.
 Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.
 Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.
 Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.
 Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.
 Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.
 This Role Is Not For 
 Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.
 People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.
 Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.
 Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.
 People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.
 The Bar 
 We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.
 Location 
 This role is based in Japan . This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Japan office at least 3 days per week.
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Technical interview
 3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.
 What You'll Own

 Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.
 Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.
 Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.
 Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

 Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.
 What We're Looking For 
 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.
 Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.
 Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.
 Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.
 Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.
 Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.
 App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.
 Tech Stack 
 Kotlin
 Jetpack Compose
 Android SDK
 Coroutines & Flow
 SQL / NoSQL
 TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.
 Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.
 Moves fast without creating messy code.
 Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.
 Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.
 This Role Is Not For 
 Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.
 Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.
 People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.
 Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.
 People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.
 Location 
 This role is based in JAPAN . This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our JAPAN office at least 3 days per week.

 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
The Role 
 BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.
 The Staff Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems . This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.
 What You'll Own 
 Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.
 Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.
 Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.
 Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.
 Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.
 Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.
 Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.
 What We're Looking For 
 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.
 Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.
 Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.
 Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.
 Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.
 Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.
 Nice to have 
 Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.
 Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams 
 Our Cloud Infrastructure team builds, operates, and improves the shared cloud platforms that support Wayve’s engineering organisation. We work with engineering teams to create secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure that meets application needs and supports scalable software delivery.
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work across cloud foundations, Terraform, Kubernetes, developer environments, observability, and FinOps. This is a hands-on role with opportunities to deepen your expertise in cloud infrastructure and governance, security and FinOps tooling, automation, observability, and platform engineering.
 Build and operate secure, scalable cloud environments with consistent governance and standards.
 Develop Infrastructure-as-Code, automation, and self-service tooling that make infrastructure provisioning and change safe and repeatable.
 Own the lifecycle and governance of Kubernetes clusters, continuously improving how they are provisioned, configured, upgraded, maintained, and recovered.
 Operate and improve shared developer environments and observability platforms.
 Work with engineering teams to ensure platforms meet application needs and support scalable software delivery.
 Contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of infrastructure and operational practices.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on: 
 Cloud foundations: secure, reliable, and scalable shared infrastructure, with consistent governance and standards.
 Terraform, Infrastructure-as-Code, and self-service tooling that help engineering teams provision and change infrastructure safely.
 Kubernetes cluster lifecycle and governance, from provisioning and configuration through upgrades, maintenance, and recovery.
 Shared developer environments and observability platforms that support engineering productivity and operational visibility.
 Security and FinOps tooling, automation, and improvements to infrastructure reliability and operational practices.
 🙌 You should apply if: 
 Essential
 Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
 3 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes administratorion, developer infrastructure, or related engineering roles.
 Experience with one or more of the following:
 At least one cloud platform, such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
 Infrastructure-as-Code tools, such as Terraform and Ansible.
 Container technologies such as Docker or Podman
 Linux environments, including distributions like Ubuntu.
 Networking, cloud architecture, system reliability, and secure access controls.
 Experience with Linux, Git, and shell scripting.
 Desirable
 Experience with multi-cloud governance, including neocloud environments.
 Experience building self-service infrastructure tools, standard provisioning workflows, or reusable platform capabilities.
 Experience operating observability platforms for metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry.
 Experience managing developer environments, such as Coder or comparable remote development platforms.
 Experience implementing infrastructure security guardrails in partnership with security teams.
 Experience improving platform reliability through incident response, recovery procedures, and reducing operational toil.
 Experience with FinOps tools, improving cloud cost efficiency and operational resilience.
 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
 More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
 How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 
 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
 🔍 The Interview Process: 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
 Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)
 Competency Interviews (Hiring manager screen on role fit, technical breadth and build / CI/CD ownership; 2 hours total)
 Deep-dive technical interviews (programming, system design and a DevOps domain interview ; 3 hours total)
 Final interview : mission & values alignment (1 hour).
 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
 What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
 A quick, honest note before you apply.
 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
 If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

description:

 The Application SW team sits within Application Engineering in Product & Delivery. We bridge AI innovation and production vehicles, defining and executing the strategy for integrating Wayve’s autonomy stack into multiple OEM platforms, and working directly with automotive customers, including major Japanese OEMs.
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 As an Application SW Engineer, you’ll be responsible for the bring-up and early validation of our AI software stack on customer hardware platforms, ensuring it performs reliably across diverse SoCs and operating systems. You’ll work closely with Verification, Release and OEM partner teams to make integration smooth and delivery dependable. Your time will be split across platform bring-up and integration, customer and partner engagement, and technical leadership, including helping to build the team.

 Executing software bring-up on customer hardware platforms (e.g. NVIDIA Drive, Qualcomm Ride).
 Porting and configuring Linux-based systems, QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments.
 Integrating and validating drivers, middleware and boot-time configurations.
 Working with Verification and Release teams to integrate hardware into CI/CD, HIL and test infrastructure.
 Working with OEM and Tier 1 teams to resolve hardware-specific integration issues.
 Implementing system-level diagnostics, logging and secure boot configuration.
 Developing automation for setup, flashing, health checks and test execution on target hardware.
 Defining and executing the strategy for integrating our autonomy stack into multiple OEM platforms.
 Building the team and providing technical leadership across integration work.
 🙌 You should apply if: 
 Essential
 8+ years of experience in embedded or automotive software development, ideally with hands-on platform bring-up experience.
 Strong proficiency in C/C++, Bash, and Python.
Deep understanding of Linux-based embedded systems (Yocto, systemd, bootloaders, device trees).
 Familiarity with QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments and the ability to configure and debug them on target hardware.
Experience with bring-up on automotive-grade SoCs (e.g., NVIDIA Orin, Qualcomm SA8295/SA8650, Renesas, TI).
 Comfortable working with hardware debuggers, flashing tools, serial consoles, and board support packages (BSPs).
 Familiarity with communication protocols like CAN, Ethernet, PCIe, SPI, I2C.
 Hands-on experience integrating embedded platforms into CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks.
 Desirable
 Exposure to automotive verification environments (e.g., HIL systems, Vector toolchains, custom CI rigs).
 Experience working in a safety-critical domain with an understanding of ISO 26262, boot-time determinism, and watchdogs.
 Understanding of secure boot, OTA updates, and system-level cybersecurity topics.

 🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team 
 Our Fleet Operations Team is responsible for maintaining the safety, performance, and operational readiness of Wayve's autonomous vehicle fleet — from routine servicing and diagnostics to urgent repairs and vehicle readiness for high-visibility events. The team keeps our fleet in peak condition to support testing, demonstrations, and real-world deployment, working closely with engineering, drivers, and operations teams to keep autonomy moving forward, every single day.
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
The Field Engineer is a hands-on technical contributor responsible for diagnosing and resolving vehicle software and hardware issues to keep the fleet operational. They will play a critical role in rapid fault triage, ensuring a 5-minute response time while strictly adhering to safety protocols. Working closely with fellow engineers and global teams, they will contribute to seamless operations through effective communication and problem-solving. As part of a newly established function within Fleet Operations, the Field Engineer will help refine processes and drive efficiency in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.
 🧩 What you'll be working on 
 Perform on-site fault triage and resolution, diagnosing and repairing vehicle software and hardware issues quickly to maintain fleet uptime.
 Follow structured fault diagnosis and repair protocols, ensuring all work is carried out efficiently and in alignment with operational workflows.
 Collaborate with fellow field engineers and cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues effectively.
 Respond rapidly to issues, meeting the 5-minute issue response to keep vehicles operational and our teams feeling adequately supported.
 Maintain clear communication with the Field Engineering Lead, providing updates on ongoing repairs and ensuring smooth handovers across geographical locations.
 Participate in on-call rotations, assisting with technical support and issue resolution across multiple regions as part of a 24/7 global support network.
 Adhere to strict safety and compliance protocols, ensuring all fault triage, diagnosis, and repairs follow the correct procedures and approvals.
 Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, identifying operational challenges and providing feedback to optimise field engineering support and efficiency.
 🙌 You should apply if 
 Essential:
 You hold a Japan Driver's License.
 You speak both Japanese (N2 or above) and English (fluency is a must).
 You have strong technical expertise — a solid understanding of vehicle diagnostics, software and hardware fault triage, and repair processes. Experience in fleet operations, automotive systems, or ADAS technology is a plus.
 You can troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly, meeting strict SLAs (5-minute response time) to keep vehicles operational.
 You communicate and collaborate well — capable of working closely with global teams, providing clear technical updates, and ensuring smooth handovers across locations.
 You have a deep understanding of safety protocols, incident management, and adherence to operational procedures to ensure secure and effective repairs.
 You're adaptable and flexible, comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment, including on-call rotations and weekend coverage as needed.
 You're familiar with diagnostic tools, software monitoring platforms (e.g., Datadog, Mender), and ticketing systems like JIRA.
 Desirable:
 Bachelor's degree ( B.Sc . or equivalent) in Automotive, Mechanical, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical discipline.
 Knowledge of ADAS on-road testing, safe vehicle-operation procedures, and relevant safety or high-voltage/EV certifications.
 High-voltage/EV certification and practical experience diagnosing EV systems.
 A demonstrated continuous-improvement mindset: able to identify recurring vehicle issues, turn field observations into actionable feedback, and help improve repair processes, vehicle uptime, and operational safety.
 Additional requirements:
 This role is based on a rota with a shift pattern, Monday to Sunday (must be able to work weekends): 06:30–15:30 or 14:30–23:30.
 On-site at our office in Tokyo or Yokohama. Tokyo will be the main place of work, but you might be required to go to Yokohama office sometimes when there is a business need.
 All applicants are required to disclose any second job as part of the application process.
 All applications are subject to a health check before/after.
 Employment is contingent on passing training, pre-employment checks and ongoing drug/alcohol testing, per our policy. You'll be tested for drugs and alcohol during your onsite interview.
🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
 More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
 🔍 The Interview Process: 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
 Recruiter Interview (30 mins, online)
 Competency Interview (60 mins, online)
 Deep-dive technical interview (60 mins, online)
 Final interview : mission & values alignment (60 mins, online)
 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
 What’s in it for you: 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
🤝 Inclusive & Fair Recruitment 
At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by applicable law.
 Wayve is committed to providing a fair and respectful recruitment process for all candidates, free from harassment and discrimination. The Company has zero tolerance for sexual harassment against job applicants or similar individuals.
 All communications relating to recruitment activities are conducted through the Company's recruitment system or using an email address with the Company's domain. Employees do not use their personal email addresses or social media accounts for recruitment-related communications.
 Employees do not engage in private communications unrelated to recruitment activities, invite applicants to private meals, request or seek a personal or romantic relationship, or otherwise initiate private contact with applicants.
 Sexual remarks or conduct, physical contact, questions concerning sexual matters, and any other conduct constituting harassment are prohibited.
 If you have any concerns, you can contact our consultation desk at peoplepartners@wayve.ai . All consultations are treated with strict confidentiality, your privacy will be protected, and no one will be subject to any disadvantageous treatment for raising a concern or cooperating with an inquiry.
 If you require any accommodations during the interview process, let us know. 
Learn more at Careers at Wayve and Values at Wayve . 
 DISCLAIMER: We won't ask about marriage, pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in our job ads or interviews. We do collect this information via an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify and improve areas of our hiring process.

 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

title: Senior Backend Engineer — Japan
description:
ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is detail-oriented, proactive, and highly collaborative to join our Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to design and build scalable backend systems, drive architectural improvements, and deliver resilient, high-performance services in production environments.
Strong technical expertise in Go, distributed systems, and microservices architecture is essential, along with experience in building and operating cloud-native applications in containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes. The ability to troubleshoot complex production issues, optimize system performance, and manage event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar streaming platforms will be key to your success in this role.
If you're passionate about building reliable, scalable systems that power high-impact products and love creating seamless infrastructure that enables innovative payment, gaming, or commerce experiences, we would love to hear from you!
ABOUT US
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain backend services that power core products and platforms.
 Develop event-driven systems using Go and Kafka.
 Build scalable microservices in containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
 Drive architecture decisions that improve performance, resiliency, and maintainability.
 Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and QA to deliver end-to-end solutions.
 Own your code in production, monitor, debug, and continuously improve service performance and reliability.
 Write automated tests and follow CI/CD best practices to ensure high-quality deployments.
 Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing across teams.
 Participate in on-call rotation to support production systems and respond to incidents.
Qualifications & Skills 
5+ years of backend development experience in Go or a similar language.
 Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, and event-based communication.
 Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
 Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and performance optimization.
 Ability to troubleshoot production issues, analyze system behavior, and drive resolution.
 Business-level proficiency in Japanese and English is required.
Nice to Have
Background in gaming, payments, or commerce systems.
 Experience in adtech or offer monetization platforms.
 Hands-on experience with Kafka or equivalent streaming platforms.
 Experience with Redis or other in-memory data stores.
 Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure).
 Familiarity with ClickHouse, Postgres, or other analytical/OLAP/OLTP databases.
 Prior experience working on internal platforms or developer-facing tools.

title: Platform Architect
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
 Join us to put AI to work for people.
You will be part of the Customer Outcomes team. Our purpose is to accelerate platform adoption and improve customer outcomes. We do this through a portfolio of services, delivered by outstanding consultants, using our ecosystem of partners, our leading practices, methodologies and tools based on our experiences from 1000's of customer engagements.
 What you get to do in this role: 
 The Customer Outcomes Platform Architect is a technical advisory role, responsible for helping our customers establish a technical foundation in the ServiceNow Platform and design solutions that improve outcomes. The Platform Architect ensures customers use leading practices around instance strategy, technical governance, core data, integrations and the technical health of the platform. This is a consultative role focused on guiding ServiceNow, partner, and customer employees on the engagement team to provide a solution on a technical architecture designed for long-term success.
 You will work with the customer across executive, platform owner, enterprise architects, and development teams during the selling, structuring and implementation of solutions.
 Be a technical expert across multiple engagements to guide customers, partners, and internal team members to provide successful customer solutions.
 Provide a variety of knowledge across multiple workflows.
 Develop relationships with technical and business leaders at the customer site to understand the role of ServiceNow in their digital transformation vision.
 Translate goals to outcomes into a customer roadmap.
 Translate business information and technical requirements into an architectural blueprint to achieve complex goals.
 Engage with the customer's Enterprise Architects to position ServiceNow as the digital transformation platform standard, integrated with the customer's core applications.
 Manage technical governance, and an delivery operating model and governance.
 Ensure instance health by working with the engagement team to reduce technical debt and align to ServiceNow leading practices.
 Support the sales effort by scoping and estimating the engagement and change orders.
 Be an active contributor of leading practices and expertise related to the ServiceNow platform.
 Maintain skills / certifications.
 Support the professional development of others through means of mentoring.
To be successful in this role you have: 
 Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
 12+ years progressive experience as part of a professional services organization; or equivalent education/experience
 Management consulting experience
 Ability to travel up to 20%
 Creativity with comfort running programs independently within a "startup paced" environment
 Success driving complex issues through analysis and resolution
 Ability to relay complex information to diverse set of audiences, both technical and non-technical
 ServiceNow certifications in aligned workflow
 Large program experience leading architecture and design
 Enterprise architecture experience
 Cloud application technology experience
 Must be fluent in Japanese
 Must be authorized to work in Japan
 FD21

In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Wizcorp 🦄🇯🇵🎮 
 Wizcorp is a highly specialized game development studio based in Tokyo and operating 100% remotely. We are a cross-cultural team of passionate individuals working together toward one goal: bringing back magic to game development.
 How? 
 We get better every day. Our technical abilities should never limit our ideas.
 We question the status quo. We don't accept yesterday's answers to tomorrow's challenges.
 We follow our moral compass. Our values guide our decisions.
 We surround ourselves with people who believe in our mission. Our staff, clients, and partners are all part of the equation.
 We learn and share. We want our successes and failures to contribute to the collective wisdom of our profession.
 Wizcorp offers a friendly and honest working environment. Our work is challenging but rewarding, with countless personal and professional growth opportunities.
This position requires you to reside in Japan during your employment with Wizcorp. 
 Wizcorp is looking for Software Engineers for a selection of diverse fields. Depending on your background, skills, and experience we’ll find the most suitable role within our teams for you. We value human skills and character as much as we do experience and proficiency.
 Is this job for me? 👨‍🦰👩‍🦳🧑‍🦲 
 You have a few years of work experience developing software professionally. C++ and C# are core programming languages in your tool box, even though you might be using one or two other languages for your daily tasks. You’re not afraid to deep-dive into the engine and code bases to make some improvements.
 Sounds like you? Then this job is for you!
 Typical day 🎮📆🕹️ 
 You might start with an hour of looking over some code with a senior engineer. You then might have the opportunity to look at optimizing a piece of AI logic, discussing as necessary with a specialist in the area. In the afternoon you may spend some time working with game designers and artists to complete feature integration.
 The ideal candidate will be able to 
 Design, test, and debug own code without assistance from other engineers
 Break down features into engineering tasks and work with other engineers to complete them
 Have an interest in working on both games and their surrounding tooling
 Confidently communicate with all members of the company
 Roles and Responsibilities 🛠️🧪✨ 
 Complete assigned engineering tasks in a timely manner 
 Test and document provided solutions to allow other developers to review and learn
 Write clear, maintainable code that passes review by senior engineers
 Estimate own tasks and deliver them in a timely manner
 Raise all blockers when they arise to the feature lead or project lead
 Follow software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, and testing 
 Take ownership of medium-sized features by breaking them into manageable tasks that can be accomplished by themselves and/or others
 Coordinate with members outside of the engineering team to deliver features in a timely manner
 Application process 🈸⚙️😊 
 ① Online selection
 We review resumes from all applicants within 2 weeks. If your profile matches our requirements, we will send you tests and challenges. Based on the results, we will contact you again to schedule the first interview.
 ② Interviews
 We conduct three interviews to assess your character, passions, skills, and interest in what we do. We also take the time to share our vision and values, as we believe you are interviewing us as much as we are interviewing you.
 ③ Reference Checks
 We conduct reference checks with your previous employers or professional contacts to better understand your experience and working style.
 ④ Offer
 We make our final decision within 2 weeks after the final interview, and send a detailed offer upon success.
 Onboarding process 🈴🗼🌅 
 We strive to make the onboarding process as smooth and worry-free as possible.
 Upon acceptance of our offer, you will receive our working agreement and our rules of employment.
 Ideally, we want you to join us within a month, but we can adjust to your current work situation.
 On your first day, your manager will introduce you to your team and will set a schedule for reviews over the 6 month probation period. We will give you all the support you need to complete it successfully.
 At Wizcorp, we grow together. 
 Senior staff will support you and provide mentorship. You will also have access to digital learning material, and your manager will help you define a training curriculum based on your career aspirations.
 You can learn more about our career philosophy here: https://www.wizcorp.jp/career
🤹 Skillset 🤹 
 Strong software development fundamentals, design theory, and development processes
 Excellent debugging skills
 Excellent written and verbal communication
 Willingness to work as part of a team and contribute to technical discussions
 Eager to learn from reviews and constructive feedback
 Strong personal time management
 ⭐ Experience ⭐ 
 University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline; or relevant professional experience
 For Japan-based candidates: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and at least 1 year of experience in the video game industry
 For overseas-based candidates: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, and at least 4+ year of experience in the video game industry
 Must have experience with C++ and C#, backed with Go
 Demonstrable Software Engineering ability
 Experience with Git or other version control systems
 Experience with multiple programming languages
 At least conversational Japanese proficiency - JLPT N3 or above 
 English proficiency (ability to read, write, and discuss technical matters)
 👍 Preferred 👍 
 Experience with game engines such as Unity, Unreal, or proprietary engine code
 Understanding of 2D and 3D math
📍 Business hours and Location 📍 
 ⏲ Flexibility in time 
 We all have different creative clocks, and you know yours better than we do.
 We will expect you to work 8 hours per day from Monday to Friday with core hours between 11:00 and 16:00 (excluding a 1-hour break). The rest will be up to you.
 🌎 Flexibility in location 
 Wizcorp fully embraces telework, and most of us work from home. Office space is also available for your convenience, and you will have access to meeting rooms and hot desks.
 We may require you to work onsite on specific occasions when using highly specialized equipment.
 Offices are located at 1 Chome-22-19 Izumi 8~9F, Suginami City, Tokyo 168-0063 ( 🗺 map )
 You must reside in Japan during your employment at Wizcorp. We offer legal support for visa applications. Depending on your situation, we may allow you to work outside of Japan during your probation period.
 👷 Employment Type 👷‍♀️ 
 Permanent
 💴 Salary 💴 
 The following tiers are currently in application for this position:
 SE1: 350~400K/month 
 SE2: 400~500K/month 
 SE3: 500~550K/month 
 All new staff members’ initial salary will be based on experience and interview evaluation.
 Includes a 6 months probation period. Salary is not affected nor changed during that period.
 💹 Raises and bonuses 💹 
 You will be reviewed once a year and your salary will be adjusted to match with gained experience and project contributions.
 Pay raises are awarded around March each year, in line with our budget and financial forecasting for the subsequent year.
 We do not offer bonuses.
 🈷️ Additional benefits 🈷️ 
 Monthly allowance for home office equipment and supplies (15,000 JPY/month)
 Private language tutoring (Japanese and/or English)
 Commute fees (however, train passes are not reimbursed)
 ♨️ Holidays and vacations ♨️ 
 Weekends and national holidays
 Summer/winter vacation: 5 days per year (paid, applicable after the probation period)
 Annual Paid Leave: 10 days per year (first year, following the probation period)
 Bereavement/funeral leave
 Sick leave: 5 days per year (paid, applicable after the probation period)
 🤝 Welfare 🤝 
 Social insurance
 Parental leave ( learn more here )
 Keywords is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and supportive working environment.

 Studio: Wizcorp
 Location: Asia Pacific, Japan
 Area of Work: Game Development
 Service: Create
 Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent
 Working Pattern: Remote
 Keywords is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and supportive working environment. 
 PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY 
 Keywords Studios is strongly committed to protecting your personal information. By sending your CV/Resume, you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and consent to your data being managed and retained in accordance with our data privacy and retention policy https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice/.

Hitachi Energy's Grid Automation business unit supports 50% of the top 250 global electric utilities. Our Grid Automation hardware, software and services portfolio unites deep domain knowledge and innovative technologies that enable customers across the globe to optimize the critical systems that power, move and connect us. Together, we’re building a more productive and sustainable world.

TAMs will act as the Support primary point of contact for the customer and also be their advocate within Support and other Workday internal teams. 
The TAM ensures business objectives and goals alignment within teams. They proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability and maintain availability of the Workday system, helping customers effectively manage their operations.

 Workday Support is looking for a dedicated, ambitious and self-driven Technical Account Manager with a passion for customer relations. This role requires a self-motivated professional with technical acumen that consistently brings a high level of commitment to customers and Workday teammates. The ideal candidate brings strong communication and project management skills as well as strong technical background and the ability to strategically and tactically navigate the challenges with large and complex customers.

 Champion and advocate for customers with internal and external stakeholders-Manage challenging situations in a fast paced environment
 Chair roundtables to ensure close communication and relationship building with key stakeholders
 Serve on and actively participate in customer steering committee meetings
 Drive customer self-sufficiency by ensuring their customers understand how to engage with the Workday Support organization and leverage tools
 Pilot new programs and drive continuous improvement initiatives for production customers-Travel occasionally up to 25% of the time (adjust depending on region)-Participate in our 24x7 program

 BS or MS in a Technical Degree (ie. Computer Science, MIS) or equivalent technical work experience and acumen 
 7+ years of experience in product support, customer success, account management or consulting for a complex B2B enterprise software solution 
 5+ years of experience successfully implementing or managing a complex SaaS solution and working with large enterprise accounts 
 Must speak and write Japanese and English fluently 
 Other Qualifications: 
 Working experience with at least one of the following business areas preferred: Human Resources, Payroll, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Financials 
 History of successful issue resolution and escalation management skills at all levels, including executive. 
 Strong leadership and stakeholder management abilities, with C-level engagement experience. 
 Collaborative team player with cross-functional engagement skills. 
 Excellent communication (verbal, presentation, written) and meeting facilitation skills.

description:
Job Description: 
 Business Overview 
 Mission: Innovating Asset Building - Creating the Future as the Financial Hub of the Rakuten Ecosystem. 
 Rakuten Securities is a core internet brokerage firm within the Rakuten Group, which operates over 70 services globally. Our goal goes beyond providing financial products; we aim to merge the Rakuten Ecosystem's vast data with cutting-edge technology to transform "asset building" into a seamless, everyday activity for everyone. 
 - Fusion of User Base and Technology: By seamlessly connecting the Rakuten Ecosystem's extensive data with financial services, we create unique user experiences unmatched by traditional brokerages. We continue to set new industry standards through asset formation support (NISA, iDeCo), AI-driven investment solutions, and partnerships with IFAs. 
 - The Frontline of Transformation: We are currently undertaking a massive core system overhaul alongside a radical reconstruction of our "next-generation development process" based on AI. We are in an exciting phase for engineers and PMs, involving legacy modernization and the evolution of AI-driven development styles. 
 - Responsibility and Authority: We maintain the robustness of critical social infrastructure while realizing high-speed new development. Rakuten Securities offers the unique opportunity to achieve this difficult balance using the group's solid network and the latest technology stack. 
 Department Overview 
 Mission: Rewriting the Organizational OS Through Technology - A Strategy Office Accelerating Rakuten Securities' Transformation. 
 Our mission is to maximize development productivity and business agility through DX initiatives and the migration to cloud-native infrastructure. We serve as the engine of transformation, leading "IT organizational reform" that encompasses workflows, evaluation systems, and vendor strategies. 
 - Creating Impact at the Frontline: Lead high-impact projects, including company-wide cloud migration and DX promotion. You will experience the tangible results of your proposals as they reshape the work styles of hundreds of engineers and fundamentally accelerate business velocity. 
 - Strategic Commander Bridging Management and Operations: Translate IT strategy into execution plans. This is a rare career path where you can modernize the organizational "OS" by leveraging both your management perspective and your deep understanding of real-world technical challenges. 
 Position: 
 Why We Hire 
 We are seeking a leader to drive the structural reform of our IT organization. 
 As Rakuten Securities continues to grow, evolving our development organization has become a top management priority. Cloud migration for infrastructure flexibility and AI implementation for dramatic productivity gains are no longer options - they are necessities. We are looking for a leader who can drive organization-wide DX and cloud initiatives based on solid technical insight. 
 Position Details 
 Innovation of Development Processes & Governance for DX: 
 - Promote the standardization and adoption of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps culture to accelerate development speed. 
 - Redesign the entire development lifecycle workflow (from requirement definition to release) with an AI-driven development mindset. 
 - Introduce metrics to visualize organizational performance (e.g., DORA metrics) and establish continuous improvement cycles. Cloud-Native Strategy & Organizational Promotion: 
 Strategic Formulation and Organizational Promotion of Cloud-Native Transformation 
 - Formulate and manage the execution of the company-wide cloud migration roadmap. 
 - Establish a FinOps framework for cloud cost optimization and apply governance across development teams. 
 - Lead technical selection and migration planning for transitioning from legacy systems to cloud-native architectures. 
 Cross-Organizational IT Resource Optimization: 
 - Collaborate with product teams to identify technical bottlenecks and propose cross-functional solutions. 
 - Formulate vendor strategies and build strategic alliances with development partners. 
 - Propose improvements to organizational structures and evaluation systems to maximize productivity as the engineering organization scales.

title: 【Data & AI】PLM Solution Engineering Lead (Teamcenter)
description:
Job Description: 
 【業務内容】
自動車メーカーおよびサプライヤーに対し、PLM（Teamcenter）を中心とした製品開発基盤の設計・導入・運用支援を担当していただきます。顧客の製品開発プロセスや業務課題を理解したうえで、PLMをどのように活用すべきかを検討し、実運用に落とし込む役割を担います。
 【主な支援業界】
 自動車業界
 【募集背景】
 本ポジションのミッションは、自動車業界のお客様に対し、PLM（製品ライフサイクル管理）の観点から製品開発プロセス全体を支援することです。
 近年、自動車業界では技術革新が急速に進み、車両の付加価値はハードウェアのみならず、ソフトウェアやコンピュータ制御によって生み出される比重が高まっています。その結果、製品開発における情報量・関係者・工程は増大し、開発プロセスの複雑性やデータ管理の重要性はこれまで以上に高まっています。
 こうした環境下では、製品開発の初期段階から信頼性の高いデジタルデータを一元的に管理し、関係者間で迅速かつ正確に共有できる基盤が不可欠です。当社では、こうした課題に対し、PLMを中核としたシステムを通じて最適な製品開発の実現を支援しており、顧客の開発現場に寄り添いながら、最適なPLM活用を実現できるプロフェッショナルを求めています。
 【自動車領域の魅力】
 ■ 世界トップレベルの最先端技術に、最前線で挑む
当社は、自動車メーカーおよびTier1サプライヤーを中心に、世界中の自動車業界を支援しています。グローバル案件も多数手がけており、最先端技術の開発・導入・運用に国境を越えて関わることができます。
 ■ グローバル知見を、日本の自動車産業の力へ
日本の自動車業界は急速な進化を遂げていますが、先進領域では依然として欧州がリードしています。当社はLuxoftをはじめとするグローバルグループで培った実績とノウハウを日本市場に還元し、次世代モビリティ時代における日本の競争力強化に貢献しています。
 【魅力ポイント】
 ・プライムベンダーとして、お客様と直接コミュニケーションを取りながらプロジェクトを推進できます。
 ・国内での取り組みを起点に、グローバル展開へとつながるスケールの大きなプロジェクトに関わることができ、自動車設計・開発のDXに取り組めます。
 ・自動車の設計開発プロセスや生産技術プロセスを間近に感じながら、PLM／CADシステムの導入および運用に携わることができます。
 【キャリアパス】
 プロジェクトマネージャー
 ソリューションアーキテクト
 PLMコンサルタント
 ※ご自身の志向や目指すキャリアに応じて、マネージャーが成長を丁寧にサポートします。
 【配属想定組織】
 ・組織の人数：約40名
 ・組織の概要(Data＆AI事業部/Auto)： Autoではデジタルコックピット、自動運転、コネクテッドモビリティなどのご支援を行っており、グローバルでは大手自動車メーカー20社以上の走行体験の向上を支援しています。
 【必須要件（MUST）】
 ・PLM／CADシステムの導入および運用経験（要件定義、変更管理、ソリューション提案、課題・問題管理等）
 ・PLM／CADシステムに関する各種ドキュメント作成経験（設計書、設定書、テスト仕様書 等）
 【歓迎要件（WANT）】
 ・英語によるコミュニケーション力
（グローバルメンバーとのディスカッションや、海外拠点への出張・導入指揮を行う場合があります）
 ・新規要件に応じたスクリプト開発・テスト・運用の経験
 ・プログラミング言語の使用経験（SQL、KornShell、PowerShell、C、Java など）
 ・OS／DBに関する知識・スキル（Linux、Windows、Oracle Database）

description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 As a Solution Architect, you will engage with internal collaborators and customers and partners to develop technical account plan/strategy and drive sales engagements to technical closure. As a key member of the sales team, you will ensure success by capturing customer use cases and designing complex technical solutions on top of Informatica Data Management Cloud. You will educate customers and internal stakeholders on the Informatica value proposition and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment and consumption in the cloud. Within our technical sales community you will be an active, constant learner with a growth mindset. You will mentor others on the team and contributing to the development of shared selling assets, knowledge stores, and enablement materials. To ensure sustained revenue growth you will contribute to pipeline generation by delivering technical workshops, being active in social media promotions, developing content for external circulation, and participating in industry marketing events. 
Knowledge & Skills  
 Intermediate certification on at least 1 Cloud Ecosystem (AWS, Azure, GCP) and 1 data related cloud technology at the level defined by the business
 Advanced knowledge of Cloud computing security aspects
 Expert level skills for Informatica services and product capabilities 
 Ability to engage VP, Director customer personas
 Credibility with data engineers, data scientists, and other technical customer personas
 Expert storytelling and presentation skills across multiple horizontal and vertically specific use cases
 Advanced technical knowledge of hybrid deployment of software solutions, Data Warehousing, Database, and/or Business Intelligence software concepts and products
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, bilingual in Korean and either English or Japanese is required.
 Ability to create and execute on a strategic technical account plan as defined by the business

title: Physical AI and Simulation Solution Architect
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.
 Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 We are seeking a Physical AI and Simulation Solution Architect to join our innovative team in Japan. This role stands out because of its distinctive combination of the newest technology, groundbreaking projects, connecting customer demands with field delivery and product engineering, improving how AI factories and industrial digital twins are developed, validated, and put into operation.
 What you'll be doing :
 As a Physical AI and Simulation Solutions Architect (SA), you will help our customers develop and integrate accelerated Simulation and AI pipelines for their digital twin services and applications. This role involves a mix of architecture consulting, hands-on engineering, and collaboration with internal and external teams.
 Lead technical sales activities of Omniverse customers by being the domain expert in several complimentary SDKs and libraries to advise customers on how to achieve their simulation goals by employing samples demonstrating NVIDIA libraries for PoCs, pilots and hybrid production deployments in the cloud and on-prem.
 Capture field insights, advocate for partner needs, and contribute technical mentorship that improves product direction, enablement resources, and team execution.
 Drive incorporation of Omniverse libraries (ovRTX, ovPhysx, ovStorage, usd-agents, etc) into partner applications, services, and enterprise workflows.
 Translate technical and business requirements into clear solution plans while coordinating with sales, product engineering, developer relations, and partner teams to resolve blockers and advance adoption.
 What we need to see :
 A solid base in one or more relevant areas, such as computer graphics, physically based rendering, physics simulation, engineering simulation, digital twins, or accelerated computing.
 Excellent communication skills in both Japanese and English.
 Hands-on success developing technical prototypes, setting up evaluations, benchmarking solutions, or supporting customer implementations of external libraries.
 7+ years of relevant engineering, technical sales, or solution architecture experience.
 Practical understanding of three-dimensional workflows and asset pipelines through OpenUSD or similar scene-description, modeling, and data-interchange technologies.
 Experience programming in Python and a higher-level language such as C, C++
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd :
 OpenUSD certification or substantial hands-on work with OpenUSD composition, schemas, validation, optimization, or asset-pipeline development.
 Background crafting digital twins or simulation workflows for AI factories, data centers, architecture and engineering, industrial systems, or other complex physical environments.\
 Knowledge of high-performance rendering techniques, physics, and simulation technologies such as NVIDIA RTX, PhysX, CUDA, multi-physics solvers, or AI surrogate models.
 Success enabling partner solutions or building workflows such as computer-aided-design conversion, synthetic data generation, defect detection, neural reconstruction, or simulation-ready asset creation.
 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Solution Architect - Agentic AI
description:

 We are looking for a Solution Architect to work with our customers and partners in Japan, promoting the adoption of Agentic AI and providing technical support to enable them to use our portfolio of GPU-accelerated computing solutions—including machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI.

 Exploring the latest advancement in model training, fine tuning and customization, while supporting building agentic LLM applications.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Infiniband and Networking Ethernet - NVIS
description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
 What you'll be doing: 
 Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
 Support operational and reliability aspects of large-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
 Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
 Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
 Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.
 What we need to see: 
 BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
 At least 8 years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center architecture
 Proficiency in configuring, testing, validating, and resolving issues in LAN and InfiniBand networks, especially in medium to large-scale HPC/AI environments.
 Advanced knowledge of EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VXLAN protocols.
 Hands-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS.
 Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
 Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
 Strong focus on customer needs and satisfaction.
 Self-motivated with leadership skills to work collaboratively with customers and internal teams.
 Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English and Japanese are essential.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Familiarity with cloud networks (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.
 Linux or Networking Certifications.
 Experience with High-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers(Slurm, PBS) work.
 luster management technologies knowledge (bonus credit for BCM (Base Command Manager).)
 Experience with GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) focused hardware/software.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps - NVIS
description:
NVIDIA is the world leader in computer graphics, artificial intelligence, and accelerated computing. For over 25 years, we have been at the forefront of research and engineering around the greatest advances in technology. Our history of innovation drives us to solve the worlds hardest problems.
 NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure/DevOps Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
 What you'll be doing: 
 Maintain large scale HPC/AI clusters with monitoring, logging and alerting Manage Linux job/workload schedulers and orchestration tools.
 Develop and maintain continuous integration and delivery pipelines
 Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self-service consumption of resources.
 Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage.
 Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level.
 Being a technical resource, develop, re-define and document standard methodologies to share with internal teams Support Research & Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements .
 What we need to see: 
 BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
 At least 8 years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center architecture.
 Knowledge of HPC and AI solution technologies, including CPUs, GPUs, high-speed interconnects, and supporting software.
 Extensive knowledge and hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including container orchestration for AI/ML workloads, resource scheduling, scaling, and integration with HPC environments.
 Experience in managing and installing HPC clusters, including deployment, optimization, and troubleshooting.
 Experience with job scheduling workloads and orchestration technologies such as Slurm, Kubernetes, and Singularity.
 Excellent knowledge of Windows and Linux systems (Redhat/CentOS and Ubuntu), including internals, ACLs, OS-level security protections, and common protocols like TCP, DHCP, DNS, etc.
 Experience with multiple storage solutions, including Lustre, GPFS, ZFS, and XFS. Familiarity with newer and emerging storage technologies is a plus.
 Proficiency in Python programming and bash scripting.
 Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for software deployment and automation.
 Comfortable with automation and configuration management tools, including Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/Chef, etc.
 Ability to communicate technical concepts and collaborate effectively with Japanese-speaking customers.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Knowledge of CPU and/or GPU architecture .
 Knowledge of Kubernetes, container related microservice technologies.
 Experience with GPU-focused hardware/software (DGX, CUDA.)
 Background with RDMA (InfiniBand or RoCE) fabrics.
 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking individuals in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.

title: Associate Principal Solution Architect
description:
Job Summary: 
 Red Hatソリューションアーキテクトチームでは、 お客様の課題にあわせたソリューションの提案が行える、経験豊富なプリセールスエンジニアを募集しています。
 このポジションでは、日本の主要なお客様企業における経営層（CxO）やIT部門責任者の「Trusted Advisor（信頼できる助言者）」として、顧客の本質的な課題に立脚し、オープンソースの「技術」だけでなく「プロセス」や「組織文化」の変革までを含めた包括的な支援を行うことがミッションです。お客様が提供するサービスや組織内の業務プロセスにおけるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの推進に向け、どのようにITが貢献していくべきか、具体的なロードマップを描き、サポートしていくポジションです。
 一方で、お客様における攻めのIT戦略とともに重要になってきているのが、既存のIT資産の運用の効率化やコストセービングです。この攻めと守りの戦略をバランスよく立案し、お客様の組織のさらなる成長を支えていくお客様の技術アドバイザーとして活動することが必須です。そのためには、技術的な知識とオープンソースへの知見、高いコミュニケーション能力やヒューマンスキルが必要になります。加えて、担当するお客様が属する業界の知識と課題、将来の方向性を理解した上でIT戦略を立案できる能力も必要となります。
 また状況によって、販売・構築パートナーと共同で提案を進めるためのコミュニケーションや作業分担の明確化など、プロジェクト管理的な側面を持つ活動も求められます。
 Primary Job Responsibilities: 
 担当する業界やお客様を深く理解し、お客様のIT戦略の立案や将来計画のデザインを提案すること。
 お客様の業務やIT環境を深く理解し、セールスチームと連携しながら営業戦略を立案すること
 お客様訪問やWorkshopの開催を通してお客様の課題を正しく理解し、Red Hat 製品をどのように取り入れることができるかを評価すること
 セールスチームと連携し、契約を獲得できるよう案件を推進すること
 Red Hatの製品およびソリューションを使ったシステム構築に関する技術情報を提供すること。
 製品知識や深い技術知識を駆使しお客様に概念実証 (POC)、プレゼンテーションやデモを提供すること。
 全ステークホルダーに進捗、状況を伝えること。
 チームメンバーが自分の成功や失敗から学べるように知識や調査結果を共有すること
 Required Skills： 
 プリセールス、セールスエンジニアリング、アーキテクトの経験（目安: 5年以上）
 大規模なプロジェクトにおいて、複数のロールで構成されるチームを構築・リードし、成功に導いた経験
 システム構築（要件定義/設計/実装/テスト）や運用に参画した経験
 案件を進めていくための優れたコミュニケーション力、プレゼン力、交渉力に加え、エンジニアリング、ビジネス、エグゼクティブレベルとの関係構築の実績
 お客様のビジネスの問題や技術的問題を発見・理解し、ソリューションがどのようにお客様のニーズや要件に対応していくのかを効果的に説明する能力
 エンタープライズソリューションおよびアーキテクチャーの知識を有すること (例: クラウド、仮想化、コンテナ、ストレージ、RDBMS、Oracle や SAP などの ERP、ミドルウェア、クラスタリング、高可用性)
 新しい技術や業務知識をキャッチアップなど、自律的・継続的な学習を実践するマインドセットを持っていること
 ロールや階層にとらわれず、オープンに意見を交換・個人の知見を惜しみなく周囲に共有し、良いアイデアを選択・昇華する姿勢を有すること
 歓迎する経験、スキル： 
 特定の業界・業種、その業界での業務システムに関する専門知識や経験
 業務課題の抽出を目的としたDiscovery Sessionや、技術的な課題を解決するアイデアを出すためのWorkshopを企画・手動した経験
 システム部門だけでなく、業務部門も含めたお客様とのコミュニケーションや提案経験
 Red Hat製品(OpenShift/Ansible等)や関連技術（AI/PFE/Agile/DevOps）の提案や設計構築の経験
 ビジネスレベルの英語力
 About Red Hat 
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. 
 Inclusion at Red Hat 
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
 Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO) 
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

title: Account Solution Architect - FSI
description:
ポジション概要（Position Overview） 
 Red Hatソリューションアーキテクトチームは、金融業界（FSI）の顧客に対し、ITの幅広い知識とオープンソーステクノロジーを活かし、顧客の未来のアーキテクチャ像を共に描きながら変革をリードする、経験豊富なプリセールスエンジニア（Solution Architect）を募集しています。 
 本ポジションは単なる製品提案にとどまりません。銀行、証券、保険などの顧客に対し、経営層（CxO）やIT部門責任者の「Trusted Advisor（信頼できる助言者）」として、顧客の本質的な課題に立脚し、オープンソースの「技術」だけでなく「プロセス」や「組織文化」の変革までを含めた包括的な支援を行うことがミッションです。変化のスピードが増す日本企業のIT運営において、従来のやり方にとらわれず、新たな仕組みや考え方を積極的に取り入れていく姿勢を重視します。 
 既存のミッションクリティカルなシステムの安定稼働とコスト最適化（守りのIT）を実現しつつ、コンテナ技術やエンタープライズAI活用によるデジタルトランスフォーメーション（攻めのIT）を加速させる。この両輪のバランスを取りながら、日本の金融機関のIT運営の改善をご支援する、非常に社会的意義の大きなポジションです。 
 具体的な業務内容（Responsibilities） 
 【戦略立案と提案】
 ビジネス価値とストーリーテリング: 金融トレンドやビジネスニーズを起点に、事例をエビデンスとした説得力あるストーリーを構築。Red Hatソリューションによる解決策を経営層へ提言し、変革に向けたビジョンを描く。 
 アカウントの深い理解とIT戦略の策定: 顧客の中長期的なビジネス・IT施策や状況を理解し、金融業界特有のトレンド、規制、課題を踏まえ、IT戦略およびロードマップを策定・提案する。 
 アカウントプランのリード: 担当営業とともにアカウントチームのリーダーとして、ビジネス課題と技術ソリューションを紐付けた包括的なアカウントプランを立案する。 
 IT運営のモダナイゼーション: 「攻めのIT（DX、AI、クラウドネイティブ）」と「守りのIT（既存資産の効率化、自動化）」を両立させるアーキテクチャやプロセスを設計・提案する。特に金融機関で重要となる、AI活用のためのガバナンスやセキュリティを考慮した次世代基盤の構想を支援する。 
 【技術的リーダーシップと実行】
 課題発掘: 顧客へのディスカバリーセッションやワークショップを主催し、潜在的な課題を発掘・具体化する。 
 ソリューション提案: 製品ありきではなく顧客の課題解決を起点に、Red Hatのポートフォリオ（RHEL, OpenShift, Ansible, ミドルウェア, AI等）を活用した最適なソリューション構成を定義し、PoCやデモを通じて技術的な実現性を証明する。 
 エグゼクティブエンゲージメント: 顧客のCxOやIT部門長との対話を通じて強固な信頼関係を構築し、技術的な観点からビジネス変革の意思決定を支援する。 
 ステークホルダー連携: 社内外（製品開発、グローバルチーム、パートナー）の専門家と連携し、総力を挙げて複雑な技術課題を解決に導く。 
 ナレッジ共有と成長: 成功事例や技術的な知見を体系化し、国内およびグローバルチームへ共有することで、組織全体の技術力向上に貢献する。 
 応募要件（Requirements） 
 【必須スキル・経験】
 プリセールス/アーキテクト経験: ベンダー企業、SIer、コンサルティングファーム、または事業会社における、エンタープライズ顧客向けのシステム提案、コンサルティング、設計、構築の実務経験（目安：5年以上） 
 優れたコミュニケーション: 顧客のCxOや部門長クラスとの関係構築能力。ヒアリング/ディスカバリー、コンサルティングセールス、プレゼンテーション能力。複雑な技術概念をビジネス価値に変換して伝える能力。 
 広範なエンタープライズ技術スタック/アーキテクチャの知識: 仮想化、クラウド、コンテナ、ストレージ、RDBMS、ミドルウェア、ERP、データ連携/API、高可用性構成、AI等 
 【マインドセット】

description:

 Strong knowledge of automation and AI.
